summary: Every local-mirror read and every artifact this CLI writes must say on stderr when the mirror is empty, because an empty planner and an unsynced planner produce identical output.
reason: The analysis commands are the whole point of this CLI and they all answer in the affirmative: capacity reports free hours, gaps reports open windows, backup writes a snapshot, feed writes a calendar. On a never-synced store each of those is confidently wrong rather than obviously wrong, and all exit 0. The hint belongs on stderr, not in the human-text renderer, because JSON is the default whenever stdout is not a terminal, which is exactly the caller that would script against a silently empty result.
validated_outcome: A mirror with no sync_state rows now emits the unsynced hint on stderr for every local read; a synced mirror emits nothing.
